_why: Verified mfr+productId COUPLES (Z2M/ZHA) with a fixed driver. The gate fails if the exact couple (mfr in manufacturerName AND pid in productId, case-insensitive) is claimed by any other driver, or missing from its pinned driver. Other pids of the same mfr are not covered. Gate: tools/ci/couple-pin-gate.js

pins.regression: P2463 a27b3db9a5 stripped from curtain_motor; re-added by variant/align jobs
pins.curtain_motor_note: Z2M/ZHA know only TS0601 for these mfrs. Compose is a mfr x pid cross-product and TS0601 is a real curtain pid, so the mfr string was removed from curtain_motor to clear the TS0601 conflict; the other mfr x curtain-pid combinations had no documented hardware.
